title: countryfriedbreaks w. sddp
body: For the sixth episode I've got an all Tennessee techno mix prepared for yall. Louisville to Nashville is only about two & a half hours on a good day, so I've been to a fair amount of shows down there through the years & been super inspired by theirs & surrounding scenes for awhile now. I wanted to highlight some of my favorite producers, mostly from Nashville, Memphis & Knoxville, from the past decade, so expect some hardgroove, distorted acid techno, aquatic electro & more!
